Home/Our Services/Design Services

Design Services

Since 2007 Microtec's engineers have been designing and manufacturing customised solutions for customer's machinery.

design.label: 02 Design projects
design.html:
Design and manufacture

Some of the products we have designed and manufactured include:

Our clients have ranged from small one man operations to large multinationals. Designs are often requested to solve specific site requirements or safety issues.

Our experience in working with electronics used in construction and mining equipment has given our engineers the expertise to ensure that all designs are robust, reliable and made to withstand harsh conditions.

01
GPS based geofence systemto prevent cranes from hitting power lines and other obstacles on a railway station construction site for McConnell Dowell. The same system was also used in Sydney during construction works for their desalination plant.
02
Light control modulesto allow customers to easily interface the crane safety computer to external warning lights to alert personnel on site when the crane is operating near capacity or in alarm situations. These modules have been installed on thousands of machines to meet crane safe requirements.
03
Jib stow detection systemsto alert operators of faults in storing a jib to the side of a crane to prevent jibs from accidentally falling off. This was in response to a request from one of Boom Logistics' branches to solve a problem they had on a mining site.
04
External LED warning lightsfor cranes to satisfy crane safe requirements. Designed to be long lasting and maintenance free in our harsh Australian conditions.
05
Height limiting systemsto prevent collision with overhead powerlines.
06
Crane alarm latching systemsdesigned for Thiess to comply with their OH & S requirements.
07
Hi rail operating systemdesigned for a client to allow operators to correctly set up and pack up a vehicle's railway track guidance system by automating the operations and monitoring pressures on the hi rail tracks.
08
Design and fit Radio Remote Control Systems

Home/Our Services/Load Systems/Front End Loader and Excavator Weighing Systems

Front End Loader and Excavator Weighing Systems

This product is the result of many years of experience in the front end loader weighing field.

loader.label: 02 Loader weighing
loader.html:
Why it matters

It is essential for quarries and mines without weigh bridges or is ideal as a backup when the loading area is far from the weigh bridge.

The front end loader weighing systems speed up the loading operation and achieve maximum filling capacity of the truck and avoid truck over loads and under loads as well as reducing laps to weigh bridges.

Weighing accuracy 1% Weighing accuracy can be within 1%.

loader.label: 03 Features
loader.html:
Features & options
The system stores and manages daily totals and can track different materials on the same truck.
Dynamic and static systems are available.
Options such as printers and data management software are also available.

Crane Safety Systems

Specialist design and fitting of machine controlled systems. From load monitoring to warning lights and powerline protection, we help keep cranes, operators and sites safe.

crane.label: 02 Crane safety
crane.html:
What we design and fit

Safety systems built around your crane

Every system is specified, fitted and calibrated by our engineers to suit your machine and your site.

01
Load monitoring systems Rated capacity and load monitoring so operators know exactly what the crane is lifting.
02
Light control modules Interface the crane safety computer to external warning lights to alert personnel when the crane is near capacity or in alarm.
03
External LED warning lights Long lasting, maintenance free lights built for harsh Australian conditions.
04
Height limiting systems Prevent collision with overhead powerlines.
05
Jib stow detection Alert operators to faults when stowing a jib, preventing it from accidentally falling off.
06
Alarm latching systems Latch alarm events so they are acknowledged, supporting site OH&S requirements.
